environment.description: AWS Lambda function running Python 3.9 on custom container image. Container entrypoint executes pivot_root(2) into /srv/sandbox prior to handler invocation, with the new root containing only: /tmp (rw, noexec via tmpfs mount options), /opt/python (ro bind-mount of dependencies), and a statically-linked pandoc binary at /usr/local/bin/pandoc. The pivot_root old root is unmounted and the mount namespace is unshared (CLONE_NEWNS). Process runs under seccomp-bpf profile that allows only: read, write, openat, close, fstat, mmap, munmap, brk, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, clone (for pandoc subprocess), execve (restricted to /usr/local/bin/pandoc via arg inspection), wait4, exit_group, futex, and getdents64. The /proc and /sys filesystems are not mounted in the new root. No environment variables beyond LAMBDA_TASK_ROOT and _HANDLER are propagated into the sandboxed namespace (credential env vars are consumed by a credential-proxy sidecar that terminates before pivot_root). Lambda extension pre-hook strips AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN from the process environment after initializing the S3 client in a separate memory-isolated thread.
